name_note: Species of this genus were formerly placed in Atopobium; Lancefieldella parvula was previously known as Atopobium parvulum.

sentences.text: Lancefieldella parvula is an anaerobic Gram-positive coccus found in human oral mucosa.
A study states that Lancefieldella parvula was previously known as Atopobium parvulum and has been associated with inflammatory bowel disease.
A case report described cultures positive for Lancefieldella parvula from a skin and soft tissue infection following a human bite.
A study of endodontic infections reported that Lancefieldella was enriched at genus level in root canals with secondary or persistent endodontic infection.
